== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[The Shield Doors Must Be Closed (Japanese)|The Shield Doors Must Be Closed]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/149261355/LcW9Jl1n10ycDyQl4IPmGQ.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 149261355.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>86d32e284bc8a407b355d3d3b3deb22c9d88151ff8a70ca439726c3384f36dd7</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
